# trash

List or restore local deletions captured during agent turns

```text
usage: openprogram trash [-h] verb ...
```

## `trash list`

List recorded deletions and their status

## `trash restore`

Restore one recorded deletion without overwriting

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `entry_id` | Deletion id from `trash list` |
